comment: Read from src/Poppy-Fields.cpp at commit 71e0bcb, the last commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.30. Four places where the code and Manual-Poppy_Fields.md disagree. The Smooth inputs run the opposite way from the Smooth knobs: the knob value is subtracted from 1 (line 688) while the input is used as it stands (line 690), so 0V at the jack gives the most slew where a knob at 0 gives none; the manual says only that the inputs replace the knobs. The length and Start inputs are truncated with int() before being scaled (lines 569 and 574), so only whole volts count and only six values can be reached, which the manual does not mention. Zoom shrinks the drawn window as 2 divided by the square of the setting (lines 635 and 636), which at the maximum of 15 is about 225 times rather than the 50 the manual names. The manual says the Petals input adds a small offset along with the absolute value; line 585 adds no offset. The Mutagens knobs are configured from -1.8 to 1.8 (lines 279 and 280) but the value is clamped to ±1.5 (lines 592 and 593), so the ends of their travel do nothing. The panel-theme submenu is plugin-wide and cosmetic, so it has no line.
